evidence_level.justification: The study is a preregistered, single-execution numerical screening of prescribed field maps: the literature cusp definition (axis null of the axis-regular bicubic flux interpolant, separatrix traced to the dielectric wall, wall cusp at the intersection cross-checked against the flux root, cells between consecutive cusps) applied to the 96 re-solved L1a sweep designs, the 128 sealed four-cell candidates, the 56 characterization cases and the P2-qualified divergent-exit-stack field, each on its accepted map and a refined map, with two binding held-out references (sealed characterization axis roots, sealed sweep axis nulls). Its recorded outcome is accepted_topology_screening. The framework admits accepted numerical evidence through a typed committed manifest, hashed artifacts at a resolvable revision, exact registered claim text and generated artifacts with provenance sidecars; that pattern is applied here through the numerical-screening gate GATE-CUSP-TOPOLOGY-V3-1 at the recorded outcome accepted-topology-screening, a fifth outcome value added for this study. Three of its four sets are L1a screening fields (not P2-qualified); the single P2 row is one finite-element field whose iron sensitivity was not tested. Nothing here is a plasma, confinement, wall-loss or performance quantity; it is not the L1 field-resolved reduction of GATE-L1 (no manufactured solution, no L0 mapping, no performance model), not L2 and not L3, and it opens none of those gates. The cusp-cell catalogue is a consumer contract under its labels; no consumer of it is admitted here.
evidence_level.name: numerical-screening

relation_to_levels.L0: independent of the algebraic L0 model; no mapping is claimed and no L0 quantity is computed
relation_to_levels.L1: consumes linear-vacuum L1a screening fields re-solved from the accepted sweep and the sealed v1/v2 records plus one P2-qualified field; no field-resolved reduction, no L0 mapping, no geometry-response prediction
relation_to_levels.L2: not coupled to any plasma model; cells and mirror ratios are geometric field descriptors offered to consumers under their label
relation_to_levels.L3: not particle-in-cell and not experimental; the kinetic-workstream axis-null planes enter only as a reported, ungated consistency reference from a workstream whose results are not admitted

evidence_level.validation_status: none: no measurement, facility, or hardware comparison exists
evidence_level.verification_tier: code verification (analytic Jacobian versus the frozen characterization classification at every null, trace versus flux-root cross-check at every wall intersection, bilinear-step comparison, bit-identical determinism replays, hash bindings to the frozen authorities, identity proofs of every rebuilt field) and solution verification at screening tier (refinement stability on a 2x map per design, held-out correspondences with two sealed references); no validation

evidence_revision_note: The results tree first exists at this record commit; the dashboard was generated from the sealed bundle two commits later and is bound at its own revision.

metrics.screening_model: separatrix cusp topology of prescribed vacuum field maps under the HEMP/DCFT literature definition (axis null, separatrix traced to the dielectric wall, wall cusp at the intersection, cells between consecutive cusps): linear-vacuum L1a equivalent-current screening fields for the sweep-v2, four-cell-v2 and characterization-v1 sets (not P2-qualified; no permanent-magnet or nonlinear-iron material model) and the P2-qualified adaptive finite-element divergent-exit-stack field (iron poles and return yoke present) for the single P2 row

paper_evidence_file.rule: check_paper.py regenerates the evidence file, the generated TeX and the sidecar from the sealed bundle and requires byte identity with the committed files; every macro therefore traces to a verified artifact hash at every check, the headline and every per-set estimand are re-derived from the per-design rows on the way, the recorded rejection of the predecessor is byte-verified and its post-hoc audit reproduced from the sealed characterization dataset, and the sealed references must hash to the identities the bundle recorded.

permitted_claim_scope: terminal state, campaign status, design, gate, replay, stability and held-out counts of the single execution

wall-cusp counts per design and per set under the literature definition, the legacy-target fractions (exactly four wall cusps; exactly four cells), cusp positions relative to the inter-magnet gaps and to the generating axis nulls, cell lengths, wall and axis mirror ratios as field ratios, and separatrix angles

the four-cell candidates' single wall cusp and its explanation by the construction of the frozen v2 definition (wall-side vector null) and source policy (weak even stages), and the characterization cases' cusp counts with the sealed search's in-channel roots (axis clusters reproduced; off-axis roots excluded by the frozen rule), so that the frozen-definition nulls remain true

the P2 row's three cusps and cells and their differences to the two recorded, ungated consistency references (kinetic-workstream axis-null planes; plasma-topology-dashboard wall maxima), stated as development context

the recorded rejection of the predecessor campaign as lineage: its gate outcome, its root cause in the held-out reference extraction reproduced from sealed data, and the correspondence under the intended filter, never as a source of numbers
the classification strings, the recorded outcome, the sealed claim boundary and the catalogue's status as a consumer contract under its labels
posthoc_audit_note: no post-hoc audit exists for the accepted bundle; every one of its 1211 files is verified byte for byte by the generator and by the checker and no end-of-line tolerance is needed. The predecessor's read-only post-hoc audit is bound under lineage_files.
prohibited_inferences: plasma confinement, cusp-loss probabilities, wall-loss rates, thrust, efficiency or any thruster performance
reading a wall or axis mirror ratio as a probability or a loss fraction
that a separatrix-bounded cell confines electrons or that the legacy multi-cell plasma picture is demonstrated
permanent-magnet or nonlinear-iron material behaviour of the L1a sets, iron sensitivity of the P2 row, or P2 qualification of the L1a fields
any kinetic-simulation or particle-in-cell result (the axis-null planes are a reported consistency reference from a workstream whose results are not admitted)
any number of the predecessor campaign (disclosed as lineage only)
a change to the frozen-definition records of the earlier admissions (their nulls remain true under their definitions)
field-resolved reduction, L0 mapping or geometry-response prediction (GATE-L1 stays closed)
opening of GATE-L1, GATE-L2 or GATE-L3
recorded_outcome_justification: The four existing numerical-screening outcomes name a field-only design-space screening (accepted-screening), a preregistered null (preregistered-null), a developmental characterization (recorded-characterization) and a test-particle screening dataset (accepted-screening-dataset). This study's sealed campaign status is accepted_topology_screening: the HEMP/DCFT literature definition of a wall cusp (axis null, separatrix, dielectric-wall intersection) evaluated on 281 prescribed field maps (three L1a linear-vacuum sets and one P2-qualified row) with every binding integrity gate true and every design stable under refinement. A fifth outcome value names exactly that, so that accepted keeps meaning admitted as recorded: the cusps and cells are geometric properties of prescribed field maps under a stated definition, never demonstrated plasma confinement, and the earlier frozen-definition nulls remain true under their own definitions.
